tagline: International Mediterranean Yacht Championship 2027: two training days and four race days in Marmaris Bay, with a prize-giving every evening. No experience needed: two professional racers are on board and we handle all the organisation.

itinerary.title: The IMYC week, day by day
itinerary.intro: A prestigious regatta in the heart of the Turkish Riviera: daily races, prize-giving ceremonies and evenings in the company of sailors from all over the world. We put the crew together so that beginners feel at ease: a racing skipper and a tactician sail the yacht and teach the basics of the sport right on the water. The yacht, the entry and the paperwork are on us — all you do is buy a ticket and pack a bag.

days.label: 24 Apr, Sat
days.title: Arrival day
days.text: We check in to the hotel, meet the team and get together for an informal dinner.

days.label: 25 Apr, Sun
days.title: First training day
days.text: Briefing at 11:00: theory and assigning roles. From 12:00 to 17:00 — training on the water, practising manoeuvres.

days.label: 26 Apr, Mon
days.title: Second training day
days.text: Briefing and theory at 11:00, then back on the water from 12:00 to 17:00, bringing the crew together before the starts.

days.label: 27–29 Apr, Tue–Thu
days.title: Race days
days.text: We head out at 11:00 and race from 12:00 to 17:00. Prize-giving and a cocktail party at 20:00.

days.label: 30 Apr, Fri
days.title: Final and gala dinner
days.text: We head out at 10:00, the final races run from 12:00 to 16:00. The closing prize-giving and gala dinner start at 20:00.

days.label: 1 May, Sat
days.title: Departure
days.text: We say goodbye and leave at 10:00. If you need to, you can fly out on Friday evening after the dinner.

itinerary.note: No experience is required: before heading out we run detailed briefings and training sessions, and roles are assigned to match your ability. We race by day and meet crews from all over the world at dinners and cocktail parties in the evening.
